verdict.rationale: CIPO is a government IP-office service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence covers online filing, search, bulk data downloads and the MyCIPO account login, but nothing mentions an MCP server or any agent-connection endpoint. Bulk data and databases are at most adjacent building blocks, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
